Analysis: Hypothesis 2 is more novel as it proposes an innovative dual-intervention approach with real‐time feedback through biosensors and time-resolved proteomics. However, its complexity raises concerns regarding plausibility and testability—the synchronization of two distinct interventions (autophagy induction and pharmacological Nrf2 activation) poses significant implementation and validation challenges, and the added technological complexity may impact safety if the feedback loop fails. In contrast, Hypothesis 1, while slightly less novel, is more straightforward, making its mechanism more plausible and experimentally testable. Its focus on a nanoparticle-based, liver stellate cell–targeted strategy is comparatively safer due to its confinement of effects and more direct mechanistic pathway that can be validated with established techniques.
